description: Explicit finite qualification scope; inventory coverage is not behavioral coverage. Unknown and unsupported never qualify a global claim.
limitations: Capability availability on each exact reference still needs black-box inventory review; current documentation is not evidence that v0.11.3 supported every listed capability.
Variant coverage is finite and risk-based; it cannot prove all possible interactions or absence of defects.
Physical devices, actual providers/accounts and production remain outside synthetic execution authority.
A gate validates evidence bindings and declared coverage, not the truth of self-reported assertions or human comprehension.
